items.title: Somalia braces for El Niño floods as millions face risk of hunger
items.description: In Bayahaaw village, on the outskirts of Jowhar in central Somalia, farmers face a difficult choice: plant crops and risk losing them to floodwaters or leave their fields bare and face potential hunger in the coming year. Nuh Adan, a farmer and community leader in Bayahaaw, said flooding caused by breached riverbanks could devastate local agriculture for months. "If the river breaks and the floods hit us, the effects will last until the next rainy season in March," Adan said.
